beats.say: Hey Matt, it's Maeve. This is your first explainer reel. Instead of reading walls of text, you just press play.
Here's how one gets made. Claude cuts a long update into a few short beats, draws each one in Figma, and I'll read them out to you.
Each reel is five to eight beats, about fifteen words each. So it's over in a minute or two.
Before, you skimmed paragraphs and stuff slipped past. Now you press play and listen while you keep working.
The same player works for thread updates, studying, and presenting anything to anyone. Tell me what you'd change.
